news.hed: A Himalayan glacier collapse has killed nearly 800 people
news.body: It happened last Wednesday. More than 3,000 are still missing in Nepal and China.

news.hed: U.S. forces struck Iranian rocket launchers on the Strait of Hormuz
news.body: Sunday. The first U.S. military action there in weeks. Iran said it would retaliate.

news.hed: Hurricane Karina formed in the Pacific
news.body: Well away from land. Forecasts say it will get stronger.

news.hed: Google Maps now labels Lake Ontario as Lake America
news.body: For people in the United States, after a Trump administration name change.

news.hed: One person was killed at a rave in Switzerland
news.body: Five others were wounded in the shooting.

sports.hed: Aaron Donald is coming out of retirement to play for the Rams again
NFL teams had to cut to 53-man rosters
The Dolphins traded for quarterback Kyle McCord
The Bears traded defensive tackle Gervon Dexter to the Falcons
The regular season opens Wednesday, September 9
